sources.title: Juxoola/LFM3-VL-2B-MNN · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction LFM3-VL-2B-MNN is an MNN-format export of LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B — a 2B-parameter language foundation model with native image understanding. The checkpoint was converted with llmexport and runs on the MNN runtime (llm engine + visual encoder) on Android, iOS, Linux and Windows, on CPU.

sources.title: LFM3-VL-2B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: 2B vision-language model with video understanding, thinking, and spatial reasoning for on-device deployment ← Back to Vision Models LFM3-VL-2B is a vision-language model in the LFM3 family designed for on-device deployment.
